abstract: Media is a vibrant ecosystem that faces constant changes as new technology is introduced. For this ecosystem to survive and thrive, leaders need to integrate this technology in a thoughtful way. That's where Joe Addalia comes in. He is currently the Vice President of Broadcast Technology for Hearst Television Inc., where he is responsible for discovering and implementing new technology. His work involves innovating workflows for News Technology, Broadcast Operations Technology, Media Workflows, and NextGenTV.
